raw_text:
Project Charter & Scope

Project Objectives

The AI Project Intelligence system aims to minimize sprint slippage and provide predictive risk advisory to engineering leaders and scrum masters.

Key Deliverables

Deliverables include automated ingestion of PDF and DOCX specifications, vector storage, and real-time semantic query retrieval.

Phase | Target Date | Status
Milestone 1 Ingestion | 2026-Q4 | Active
